status: DECLARED before the governing run (tools/run_lirf_gate.py); the scratch reads that motivated it (same tables, 01:45-02:00 UTC) are disclosed below; no official score enters this round
purpose: The LIRF network (ens_ctx_lirf) compresses long delays far more than the LIRF trees (ens_v22_lirf_q) and v9: on the July 2025 set thinned to July 2026's coverage (LIRF dark: every LIRF row on the unmatched blend, as the ranking's 15,515 July 2026 LIRF rows are), the rows where the tree sits more than 600 s above the network carry a much larger error under the shipped unmatched blend (v9 0, net 0.583, tree 0.417) than under a tree-leaning blend. Natural months rarely put LIRF rows on the unmatched blend, so this exposure is invisible in the four recipe months and specific to the July 2026 regime, like the EHAM/January exposure that v35's u300 gate addressed. A disagreement gate leans to the tree (and, in one variant, to v9) on LIRF non-population rows where tree - net exceeds a threshold; every other row keeps v34's LIRF blend exactly.

definitions.D_lirf: ens_v22_lirf_q - ens_ctx_lirf (LIRF tree minus LIRF network), per row, from the same out-of-sample components the blend uses
definitions.gate: rows of the scope with D_lirf > T take value max(lean.v9 * v9 + lean.net * net + lean.tree * tree, -12); other rows keep the v34 blend
definitions.population_rows: excluded everywhere (the fixed scope: on the development rows the rows where |v33 - v9| <= 1 s, on the ranking the recipe's 'fixed' scope)

components.tree: runs/coverage_regime/measure/2025-07/predictions.parquet: thinned:ens_v22_lirf_q (seasonal-fold LIRF trees on the thinned tables)
components.net: runs/adsb_ctx/regime_check_lirf/2025-07.parquet: ens_ctx_lirf:thinned (seasonal-fold LIRF network on the thinned tokens)

thinned_july.role: the July 2026 regime analog (LIRF matched 0.6% against 0.2% in the ranking): the primary read for the unmatched scope

natural.rows: runs/lomo_dev/rows.parquet (LOMO January/July, fair November/December): v9, lirf_net, lirf_tree, label, day, matched
natural.role: the matched scope's read (July, November, December) and a no-harm check of the unmatched scope on the naturally dark January and the few unmatched rows of the other months

metric.primary: squared error on the scope's rows with labels below 20,000 s (one-day and clock-day labels are outside what the gate is for and dominate any unfiltered sum: one July row with label 87,002 s alone is 60% of the thinned LIRF sum); the unfiltered change is reported alongside
metric.interval: paired-day bootstrap of the SSE change, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929, on the scope's days

rule.unmatched_part: eligible when the thinned-July primary SSE change is at most -1% with its paired-day 95% interval below zero, and no natural month's unmatched-scope interval lies entirely above zero
rule.matched_part: eligible when the natural-July matched-scope primary SSE change is at most -0.5% with its interval below zero, and neither November's nor December's matched-scope interval lies entirely above zero
rule.combined: a candidate with both parts needs both; selection = among eligible candidates the lowest sum of the thinned-July unmatched primary relative change and (if present) the natural-July matched primary relative change; otherwise nothing
rule.note: the natural months hold few gated rows on the unmatched scope (2-11 per month), so their intervals are wide; they serve as no-harm checks only

export.construction: base file + (gated LIRF blend - v34 LIRF blend) on the gated rows of the ranking's LIRF non-population scopes, from the final-file dry run's recipe components (runs/final_dryrun/run/recipe/detail.parquet), floored at -12 s; every other row byte-identical to the base
